summary: All 138 figure-selected genes matched the registered aged exenatide-versus-vehicle comparison, and 137 agreed in direction. Atp4a was the sole exception: the authors plotted a decrease, while edgeR estimated log2FC +0.0147 (FDR 0.963). The selected genes meet the concordance-v2 direction criterion, and the comparison reproduced byte for byte. [Published figures](https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S1550413125004747-mmc3.pdf)
openIssues: The reviewed sources provide no complete gene-level author table with numeric effects, P values and FDRs. Genome-wide concordance and inference remain unassessed. The proposal omits a numeric comparison spec and full-verification sign-off.
